Without access to these platforms, creators are unable to scale their businesses, protect their data, and maintain full ownership of their online stores. This is where sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in – a permanent structural alternative that enables creators to build and deploy their own online stores, free from the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built on a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments. By leveraging these tools, creators can host their online stores, process payments, and store customer data, all while maintaining full ownership and control over their digital assets. This architecture is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, making it an attractive option for creators who want to take control of their online businesses.
